about_the_game:
A Relaxing Story-Rich 2D Platformer based on T.C. Aeelah’s heartwarming book.

“So it’s Simple!” is a heartfelt 2D platformer inspired by T.C. Aeelah’s beloved book, blending gentle exploration with emotional storytelling. Step into a beautifully hand-drawn world where every leaf, stone, and cloud whispers a part of the story.

🌊 About the Game

In this relaxing adventure, you’ll guide Ivo, a curious little boy, on a journey through a vibrant and mysterious world. Along the way, a playful fairy — who is also a butterfly’s best friend — will accompany Ivo, giving him quests, riddles, and a sprinkle of magic.

But Ivo isn’t your typical hero. He doesn’t like chewing food, and sometimes, the simplest tasks feel like the biggest adventures. With each step, he’ll learn that even small moments — tasting fruit, listening to the waves, or following the wind — can be magical.

🧩 Features

  • A story crafted with heart: Based on the emotional journey from T.C. Aeelah’s “So it’s Simple”, experience themes of growth, connection, and rediscovering wonder.

  • 2D Platforming with a twist: Jump, run, and interact with the environment in playful yet meaningful ways.

  • Relaxing Exploration: Discover hidden secrets, solve gentle puzzles, and take your time.

  • Atmospheric Visuals: Handcrafted cute, colorful environments inspired by nature and childhood dreams.

  • Emotional Soundscape: An original soundtrack that grows with the story — from lighthearted melodies to touching emotional pieces.

🌸 Themes & Moods

  • Relaxing & Emotional

  • Nature & Discovery

  • Cute but Meaningful

  • Story-Rich Narrative with Heartwarming Moments

👤 Who is it for?

  • Players who love calm, story-driven experiences.

  • Fans of cozy indie platformers with unique characters.

  • Anyone who cherishes games that touch the heart while keeping gameplay simple yet rewarding.

📖 A Book Comes to Life

This game isn’t just based on a book — it’s a love letter to simple joys. Whether you’ve read T.C. Aeelah’s story or not, So it’s Simple! will invite you to slow down, take a breath, and find beauty in life’s smallest moments.

Wishlist Now and step into a world where simplicity becomes magic.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible

  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
